infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Qarota needs access to your microphone to record voice notes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Qarota needs access to your photos to let you upload pictures and videos.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Qarota needs access to your camera to take profile photos, videos, and verification selfies.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Qarota needs permission to save photos to your gallery.
